'''Muftak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] seen in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Leave the kid alone, or answer to me.|Muftak|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref>}}
[[File:MuftakEGC.jpg|left|thumb|Muftak.]]
Muftak was orphaned on the steps of [[Docking Bay 12]] of the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] spaceport on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Star Wars Screen Entertainment">[[Star Wars Screen Entertainment|''Star Wars'' Screen Entertainment]]</ref> He grew up among the cantina's regular, local customers, performing odd jobs to make a living. He always knew that he was different from almost every other race that passed through Mos Eisley, but he couldn't learn who or what he was. He searched out information from his friend, [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]], but Nadon had never seen a Talz before.

In time, Muftak found and adopted the abandoned [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] female named [[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]], and the two were nearly inseparable. Together they were known as pickpockets and thieves, with Muftak providing the brawn, while Kabe provided the brains.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope Second Edition">[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope'', Second Edition]]</ref>

Just after the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] blasted out of Mos Eisley,<ref name="Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Muftak and Kabe decided to rob [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Desilijic Complex/Legends|Mos Eisley townhouse]], where [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]] had established the Hutt's treasury and financial headquarters. They were rewarded when they were able to rescue a datadot from [[Barid Mesoriaam]], who was being tortured by Jabba for information on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Muftak and Kabe barely escaped, but were paid 15,000 credits and a pair of travel vouchers signed by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. They fled Tatooine, traveling to both [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]] and [[Chad/Legends|Chad]] before visiting other planets.<ref name="Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe">{{StoryCite|story=Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> During their stay on the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Star of Empire]],'' Muftak and Kabe evacuated in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] when [[Systems Infiltration Manager|SIM]] triggered a critical reactor meltdown alarm.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: The Doomsday Ship">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Doomsday Ship]]''</ref> Muftak wrote his autobiography, ''[[Sands in Winter]]'' during this time.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species real-world book">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>  

==Behind the scenes==
Although uncredited, Muftak was played by [[Laine Liska]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 12">[[Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 12|''Star Wars Official Poster Monthly'' 12]]—"The Cantina Aliens"</ref>

According to a 1978 memo, Muftak was going to be named ''Cullatran'' in ''A New Hope''. The name "Muftak" was given to this character in ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.

On set, Muftak went by the nickname ''Spider-Man''.<ref name="SWI95">{{InsiderCite|93|May The Facts Be With You: Part One|May The Facts Be With You: Part One: #1-50}}</ref>

In [[1979]], Muftak appeared in a 30 second [[Star Friends|commercial]] produced for the U.S. Department of Transportation. He was drunk, and his [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] friend helped him home.
